title: Exhaustion for Covering-Group Supercuspidal Data
body_html:
Exhaustion for Covering-Group Supercuspidal Data

The covering datum \(\widetilde\Sigma\) gives an irreducible genuine supercuspidal representation \(\widetilde\pi_{\widetilde\Sigma}\). Two such representations are isomorphic exactly when the covering data are equivalent. For the metaplectic cover in the relevant type I dual pairs, every genuine supercuspidal representation is obtained from such a datum under the paper's large-\(p\) hypotheses.
proof_html:
Extraction

Irreducibility follows by comparing intertwiners: the adjoint action of the cover factors through \(G\), and the chosen splitting turns the intertwining calculation into Yu's ordinary intertwining equality \(I(\eta_\Sigma)=K\). Equivalence is proved by reducing to Hakim-Murnaghan equivalence and then to depth-zero types after aligning the semisimple elements. The metaplectic exhaustion uses conservation relations to move to an odd orthogonal partner where ordinary Kim exhaustion applies, then returns through Proposition 9.1.
